purpose: Regression validation of the numerical XSA correction after the separate frozen long phase
numerical_case: GPT W128 D4 H4, four length9 rows including repeated prefixes and nonconstant suffixes; fixed seed147; fixed RMS epsilon2^-23
numerical_reference: CPU FP64 with identical FP32 parameters and rotary tables
learning_recipe: Unchanged original test_div97 loader and train(): P97 padded vocabulary128, W128 D1 H4, batch512 replacement, half-table split and same generator evaluation draws, answer-only CE, 1000 updates, eval10, eval_iters1, no early stop
execution: Python3.15/Torch2.15 CUDA FP32 highest; forward and backward torch.compile(mode=max-autotune,fullgraph=True,dynamic=False); optimizer uses original foreach implementation
learning_check: Each final heldout accuracy >=99%; record all curves and first crossings. Compare paired variants and original historical mean400 crossing; no automatic baseline replacement.
retention: Fresh process per case; keep every exception, partial curve, and full model/optimizer/sampler checkpoint; no success-only seed selection
limits: Six short regression runs, not a second long grokking phase or a residual-architecture ablation. Unchanged historical eager baseline is context, not a bitwise compiled replication. No learning improvement is assumed.
